items.title: A lethal dinner
items.surface: A woman is planning to kill her husband during dinner. However, she commits suicide while preparing it.
items.truth: She was planning to kill him by poisoning the food with some pills that she had in her bag. When she went to grab them, she noticed that they were not there, and that her son had swallowed them, thinking they were sweets. She couldn't bear it and took her own life.

items.title: What an incredible sight!
items.surface: A woman is looking through the window and sees a man with a knife. However, she does not have enough time to call the police before being murdered.
items.truth: What the woman really saw was the reflection of the murderer, who was already inside her house, behind her.

items.title: Cry, baby, cry
items.surface: Cindy is amongst a crowd of people when she is murdered. However, nobody notices her cries.
items.truth: Cindy was in a movie theater, watching a horror movie. A very scary scene started. While everybody was screaming the murderer - who was behind her - was killing her.

items.title: Sweet dreams
items.surface: Matthew keeps reading a bedtime story to his son despite the blackout.
items.truth: Matthew was blind and he usually read bedtime stories to his son from a braille book. That night there was a blackout, but this did not stop him from finishing the story.

items.title: Gone with the wind
items.surface: If the wind hadn't blown so strongly that night, Angela would still be alive.
items.truth: As it was windy, Angela decided to go to a field to fly her kite. At twilight, she could not see the nearby transmission tower. When her kite got tangled in the cables and she tried to untangle them, she was electrocuted.

items.title: Salt
items.surface: The cadets became the cause of a mass buying up of salt in the whole city.
items.truth: Cadets were supposed to shovel the snow. But they were lazy so they strew the ground with salt. They bought lots of salt to perfrom it. When old people saw military men buying lots of salt, they thought there'll be a war soon and began to wreak havoc and buy up salt.

items.title: Jump
items.surface: A man jumped out of plane. And he survived.
items.truth: The plane wasn't flying.

items.title: An uncommon man
items.surface: A man lives on the 10th floor of a building. Every morning he takes the elevator to the ground floor to go to work. Upon returning from work he goes up always to floor 7th in the elevator. Then he goes upstairs the 3 remaining floors.
items.truth: The man is very short so he has no problem to press the button on the ground floor but he does not reach the 10th floor button. The maximum he reaches is up to the 7th floor button.

items.title: Taxi
items.surface: A woman asks a driver to take her home. The whole way she talks, too much. The taxist tells her: "I'm sorry but I am deaf." The woman falls silent. But when she goes out of the taxi, she understands that the driver isn't deaf.
items.truth: The taxist have heard and understood where her house was.

items.title: Hearing aid
items.surface: A man was furious, when he realized that he can hear better without hearing aid that he was using the last 20 years. He went to his doctor to complain but the specialist became even more furious than him.
items.truth: The man was wearing the hearing aid on his healthy ear.

items.title: A murder outdoors
items.surface: A man was walking down the street when he suddenly started to choke the woman walking by him. He was taken to the police station but soon after was released.
items.truth: This woman was his wife. Some years ago she staged her death and her husband was found guilty. He already got out of jail and now can not be convicted for the same crime one more time.

items.title: No light
items.surface: A man woke up at night feeling thirsty. Then he turned off the light everywhere and went to bed again. In the morning he woke up, looked out of the window and yelled. Soon after he committed suicide.
items.truth: The man was caretaker. Accindetally he turned off the lighthouse and it caused some shipwrecks. When he woke up, he realized what he have done.

items.title: Exam
items.surface: Students are taking an exam at military academy. One of them chooses a ticket and goes to his seat to get prepared. After some minutes he goes to the professor, silently gives him the student's record-book and leaves the classroom. The student got the excellent.
items.truth: It was a morse code exam. During exam, the professor was tapping the message saying that any student may come up to him and get the excelllent.

items.title: A death in a museum
items.surface: A man wearing a balaclava runs out of a museum carrying a painting under his arm. A police officer sees him, shoots him dead and commits suicide soon after. A couple of days later, the man with the painting is buried and named favorite son of the city.
items.truth: During a cold spell, there is fire in a museum and its director tried to save the most valuable painting from the museum's collection. The police officer had not noticed the fire and thought the man with the painting was a thief. He told him to freeze but since the director was deaf he did not hear the police officer. When the police officer realized what he had done, he committed suicide.

items.title: Lost
items.surface: Jack goes on a trip with his compass. After a long walk, he stops to eat a sandwich. He is not able to find his way back afterwards.
items.truth: Jack was a scientist who worked near the North Pole. When he went walking, he walked towards the north and he stopped to eat his sandwich exactly at the North Pole. When he tried to return home, his compass was useless, since every direction pointed South.

items.title: Lucky me
items.surface: Peter wins the raffle and commits suicide.
items.truth: A group of people were snowed in. They decided to do a raffle to decide who should die so the others could eat his/her corpse to stay alive. Peter's name was selected so he had to take his own life.

items.title: I am here!
items.surface: Michael manages to get shot; in doing so he saves his own life.
items.truth: Michael was a soldier on the battlefront. The day of a big attack was approaching. When none of the other soldiers were looking, he put out an arm, so that the enemy would shoot at it. He was then taken to the hospital, and his life was no longer in danger.

items.title: It didn't seem that serious
items.surface: Anthony couldn't have imagine his cold would be the cause of his death.
items.truth: There was a gas leak at Anthony's house but since he had a cold, he could not smell it. He died when he started a fire, as he was cooking his dinner.

items.title: Try hard
items.surface: A salesman tries too hard to get a sale and as a result ends up dying.
items.truth: The salesman sold bulletproof vests. One day, to prove the quality of his product to a customer, he put one of them on and insisted the client to shoot him. The client accepted but unfortunately he missed the shot and shot the salesman in the head.

items.title: A fratricide
items.surface: A man kills his brother in front of a crowd of people. However, no one reports him.
items.truth: The man worked as executioner and his brother had been sentenced to death.

items.title: Employee of the Month
items.surface: Francis dies of a heart attack at work. His colleagues are there when it happens. However, they do not call for help until Francis dies.
items.truth: Francis was a theather actor and suffered a heart attack in the middle of a performance. However, he was playing someone who was having a heart attack. Therefore, both his colleagues and the audience simply thought that he was giving a really impressive performance.

items.title: Unopened package
items.surface: A man is found dead in a filed. Lying next to him is an unopened package.
items.truth: The man was skydiving and his parachute did not open. The unopened package was his parachute.

items.title: Dressed to die
items.surface: A woman finishes getting dressed and dies.
items.truth: There was a very venomous spider in one of her shoes. When the woman put on her shoes, the spider bit her.

items.title: The dancing dead
items.surface: A couple of dancers die around a dance competition.
items.truth: During a tango competition, another - very competitive - couple poisoned the rose that another couple passed each other during their routine, so that the couple would die. The poisoned rose killed this couple and the others won the contest.

items.title: The parrot
items.surface: A woman walks into a pet store to buy a parrot. The seller offers her one, telling her that it can repeat everything it hears. Some days later the woman - feeling cheated - goes back into the store to get her money back. However, she comes back home with the parrot and not her money.
items.truth: The parrot was deaf. It could not repeat anything, since it could not hear anything. However, the seller did not return the money to the woman because he never lied to her.

items.title: Death at the wheel
items.surface: In the front of a car, a woman is found dead. There is a gun in the back seat, out of her reach. The windows are closed and the doors are all locked.
items.truth: The woman was sitting in a convertible and the top was down. The murderer shot her and threw the gun into the back seat of the car.

items.title: Death: delayed
items.surface: Helen never thought that her decision to travel by plane would save her life.
items.truth: A few days earlier Helen had been operated on. Before boarding the plane, she had to go through the metal detector, which kept going off, despite the fact that she had removed everything metal she had on. After an X-ray examination, it was discovered that the doctors had left a scalpel inside her body. If Helen had not discovered it in time, she would died for sure.

items.title: Red high heels
items.surface: A woman buys a new pair of red high heels. Hours later, she dies.
items.truth: Her husband was a magician that was doing a gun trick with an apple on her head and his eyes closed. He didn't realize that she was wearing high heals so he didn't calculate the height accurately.... so he killed her.

items.title: The best day of her life
items.surface: She thought that it was the best day of her life moments before she died.
items.truth: At the end of a theather play, the lead actress appeared and the audience began to applaud. At that time there was a failure with the scenery and it started to collapse on stage. The oublic rose from their seats screaming, trying to warn the actress but she thought it was a standing ovation and she was crushed.

items.title: Jack and Judy are dead
items.surface: Jack and Judy were lying on the floor dead. There was a puddle of water and broken glass on the floor. How did they die?
items.truth: Jack and Judy were two goldfish that swam in a small aquarium placed on a shelf. One afternoon, a cat sneaked into the room through the window and hit the aquarium that fell off the shelf and broke against the ground.

items.title: The lost treasure
items.surface: Jimmy hid a treasure but when he wanted to recover it, he was not able to.
items.truth: Jimmy buried a treasure when he was 8 years old. He had written a note when he was younger with how many steps he would take to find his treasure. But now that he was grown up, his stride was much longer and he could never find his treasure.

items.title: A mysterious call
items.surface: A man is lying awake in bed. He makes a phone call, says nothing, and goes to sleep.
items.truth: He is in a hotel and is unable to sleep because the man in the adjacent room is snoring. He calls the snorer up (at this hotel, like many others, the phone numbers are based on the room number). The snorer wakes up and answers. The first man hangs up without saying anything and goes to sleep before the snorer starts snoring again.
